headline: Campus to Invest More Than 100 Million Dollars in Second Phase of Santa Rosa Industrial Park
summary: Kampus will invest more than $100 million in phase II of the Santa Rosa industrial park in Ixtlahuacán. The phase covers 35 hectares and 134,000 square metres of leasable space, anchored by a Mabe distribution centre.
why: Industrial parks are real estate developments leased to manufacturers and distributors, and Mabe is a major appliance maker in Mexico.
original_headline: Kampus invertirá más de 100 millones de dólares en segunda fase de parque industrial Santa Rosa
